# Comfy VEED Dubbing- Video Translation

Translate the speech in a video into another language with VEED Dubbing: each speaker's voice is cloned and their lips are re-synced to the translation. Pick between the cheaper standard tier and pro, which adds regional accents and stereo audio. Built for footage with a visible face and a talk track. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_veed_dubbing.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
